As a cell divides, where does each chromosome go?
一个细胞分裂时，每条染色体去了哪里？
Live cells lack a general way to label chromosome identities stably through mitosis.
目前缺少能在活细胞有丝分裂过程中稳定标记染色体身份的通用方法。
In fixed cells, G-banding reveals a recognizable pattern of light and dark bands.
在固定细胞中，G 显带产生可识别的深浅条带。
Rehydrated chromosomes retain more of their shape. Without the bands, their identities are harder to read.
复水后的染色体保留了更多形态特征。缺少条带时，身份也更难辨认。
Fluorescence in situ hybridization, or FISH, uses a known DNA sequence to establish a reference identity.
荧光原位杂交，也就是 FISH，通过已知 DNA 序列提供参考身份。
ChromoPix learns from both banded and bandless images to segment chromosomes and predict their identities.
ChromoPix 从显带和无条带图像中学习，分割染色体并预测身份。
Follow this one chromosome. We measure its relative area, elongation, solidity, circularity, and tortuosity.
先看这一条染色体。我们测量相对面积、伸长程度、实心度、圆度和曲折度。
UMAP puts those measurements on a two-dimensional map. One point is one chromosome.
UMAP 将形态测量映射到二维空间中。一个点代表一条染色体。
You map puts those measurements on a two-dimensional map. One point is one chromosome.
Now pull back. Across more than seven hundred thousand instances, chromosomes organize by shape. Color marks chromosome class.
拉远来看，超过七十万个染色体实例按形态组织在一起，颜色代表染色体类别。
The G-banding and FISH maps show a similar order across chromosome classes.
G 显带与 FISH 的形态图谱呈现相似的类别排列。
That agreement gives us a reference for interpreting chromosomes in living cells.
这种一致性为解读活细胞染色体提供了参照。
ChromoPose separates chromosomes in three dimensions. Tracking links their instances as the cell divides.
ChromoPose 在三维中分割染色体，再通过追踪将各帧中的实例连接起来。
ChromoLift learns how a flat projection relates to the measured shape of the same three-dimensional chromosome.
ChromoLift 学习二维投影与同一条染色体实测三维形态之间的关系。
ChromoID compares a live chromosome with a reference library, using several shape features together.
ChromoID 综合多种形态特征，让活细胞中的染色体与参考库进行匹配。
A withheld fluorescent tag provides an independent check on the predicted identity.
推断时留出的荧光标记，可用于独立核验预测身份。
In patient-derived tumor cells, ChromoWorld detected an unusual pattern of chromosome fourteen segregation.
在患者来源的肿瘤细胞中，ChromoWorld 发现了 14 号染色体的异常分离。
The images suggested that one daughter received two copies and the other received four.
成像结果提示，这次分裂的两个子细胞分别获得了两份和四份拷贝。
We isolated individual daughter cells by micromanipulation and grew them into separate clones.
我们通过显微操作分离单个子细胞，并分别培养成克隆。
The copy-number differences persisted across passages.
拷贝数差异在连续传代中得到保留。
Higher-copy clones showed stronger AKT signaling and greater sensitivity to capivasertib ex vivo.
高拷贝克隆的 AKT 信号更强，对 capivasertib 也表现出更高的体外敏感性。
Higher-copy clones showed stronger A K T signaling and greater sensitivity to capivasertib ex vivo.
The clinical team independently chose capivasertib with endocrine therapy.
临床团队独立选择了 capivasertib 联合内分泌治疗。
At eight weeks, liver target lesions had shrunk nearly a third. By eighteen weeks, nearly half.
到第八周，肝脏靶病灶直径总和下降近三分之一，到第十八周下降近一半。
Serum tumor markers fell, and measures of liver function improved.
血清肿瘤标志物下降，肝脏生化指标也有所改善。
Daily function improved, with less liver pain and fatigue.
患者日常活动能力改善，肝区疼痛和疲劳减轻。
Watching a cell divide can point to a treatment hypothesis worth testing.
观察细胞如何分裂，可能为提出值得进一步验证的用药假设提供线索。
